sentences.text: Coracias chauvireae is an extinct bird belonging to the family Coraciidae, commonly known as rollers.
The species was described in 2026 by N. Zelenkov using a tarsometatarsus fossil from the Early Pleistocene Taurida Cave in central Crimea.
It was designated as a new species upon its description, and its taxonomic status is currently considered valid.
This species represents the oldest known fossil evidence of the genus Coracias found in Eurasia, with fossils dating to the Pleistocene epoch.
